lede: The county's planning boards will hear a presentation Tuesday on Colorado's new Low Energy and Carbon Code — building standards that could reshape how structures get approved in the box canyon. Otherwise it's a light week for government business, with most other meeting agendas still pending. Wednesday brings the Livable Telluride kick-off party and a screening of "Forever Wild" celebrating valley floor protection.

notable.stake: New building codes could change approval process for local construction
